description: Power-user escape hatch: GET any Accelo API path not wrapped by a dedicated tool. READ-ONLY — only GET is allowed. Pass the FULL API path after the host, starting with a slash, INCLUDING any query string, e.g. "/api/v0/companies?_limit=1&_filters=status(1)" or "/api/v0/tasks/123". Returns { meta, response }.

path.description: Full API path after the host, starting with "/", e.g. "/api/v0/invoices?_limit=5".

name: accelo_request
title: Raw read request
